name.value: Painted Boat Resort Spa and Marina

description.value: Painted Boat Resort Spa and Marina is a 31-villa waterfront resort set on five acres of prime marina frontage in Madeira Park on BC's Sunshine Coast, reachable by BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay followed by a scenic coastal drive. The property is anchored by an award-winning spa and serenity garden, a seasonal infinity pool overlooking the harbour, and the Lagoon Restaurant serving regionally sourced coastal cuisine. Guests arriving by private seaplane can land directly at the resort's marina, making it a genuinely multi-modal destination.
